text: A box holds 8 red pens and 5 blue pens. How many pens are in the box? Give the number only.
Mia has 24 stickers and gives away 9. How many stickers does she have left? Give the number only.
A notebook costs 3 dollars. How much do 7 notebooks cost, in dollars? Give the number only.
There are 6 rows of chairs with 8 chairs in each row. How many chairs are there? Give the number only.
A train travels 45 miles in one hour and 30 miles in the next hour. How many miles does it travel in total? Give the number only.
Sam reads 12 pages a day for 4 days. How many pages does Sam read? Give the number only.
A pizza is cut into 8 slices. Three people eat 2 slices each. How many slices are left? Give the number only.
Lena has 50 dollars. She spends 18 dollars and then 7 dollars. How many dollars are left? Give the number only.
A class has 14 girls and 11 boys. How many children are in the class? Give the number only.
Each pack has 6 cards. How many cards are in 9 packs? Give the number only.
A rope is 30 metres long. A piece of 12 metres is cut off. How many metres remain? Give the number only.
There are 5 shelves with 11 books on each shelf. How many books are there? Give the number only.
A baker makes 40 rolls and sells 27. How many rolls are unsold? Give the number only.
One ticket costs 4 dollars. What do 15 tickets cost, in dollars? Give the number only.
A tank holds 20 litres. 8 litres are poured out, then 3 litres are added. How many litres are in the tank? Give the number only.
A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left? Give the number only.
What is the capital of Canada? Reply with the city only.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Reply with the symbol only.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Reply with the planet only.

How many sides does a hexagon have?
A) 5
B) 6
C) 8
D) 7
Reply with the letter only.

What is 2 to the power of 5?
A) 16
B) 32
C) 64
D) 10
Reply with the letter only.
What is the boiling point of water in Celsius at sea level? Give the number only.
How many days are in a leap year? Give the number only.
How many minutes are in one hour? Give the number only.
Reply with exactly the word banana and nothing else.
Reply with exactly the word yes and nothing else.
Reply with exactly these three words and nothing else: red green blue.
Begin your reply with the characters ANSWER: and then the word ok.
Your entire reply must be the two characters OK.

Reply with the single digit 7 and no other number.
